products.name: Single-Family Home Leasing
products.description: Leasing of wholly and jointly owned single-family homes to residents, involving acquisition, renovation, and ongoing maintenance of properties. Delivery requires physical real estate assets, in-person property management, and regulated leasing operations.

products.name: Third-Party Property and Asset Management Services
products.description: Provision of professional property and asset management services for single-family homes owned by third parties, including joint venture partners. Services include leasing, maintenance, and resident relations, delivered through in-person teams and digital platforms.

products.name: Single-Family Home Development and Construction
products.description: Development and construction of new single-family homes and rental communities, both for internal portfolio growth and potentially for external customers, utilizing in-house land development and construction expertise. Requires physical construction, land acquisition, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Developer Lending for Homebuilders
products.description: Selective financing provided to third-party homebuilders for the development of new single-family home communities, supporting housing supply and creating future acquisition opportunities. Delivered as financial capital to external developers.

products.name: Security Managed Services
products.description: Ongoing, proactive cybersecurity services including managed detection and response, vulnerability management, SOC-driven monitoring, firewall management, and secure network architecture, delivered by in-house experts under recurring contracts.

products.name: Compliance Consulting Services
products.description: Advisory and implementation services to help clients achieve and maintain compliance with industry regulations and frameworks (e.g., CMMC, HIPAA, FISMA), including risk assessments, audits, and continuous monitoring, delivered by certified professionals.

products.name: Incident Response and Digital Forensics
products.description: Specialized services for rapid identification, containment, investigation, and remediation of cyberattacks, including digital forensics and breach assessments, performed by elite cybersecurity teams using advanced threat intelligence.

products.name: Security Testing and Training
products.description: Comprehensive security assessments such as penetration testing, red/purple team exercises, and cybersecurity training programs (including industry certifications), delivered by experts to improve client defenses and regulatory readiness.

products.name: Cybersecurity Software Solutions
products.description: Proprietary software platforms for threat detection, monitoring, compliance management, and risk assessment, including AI-driven and cloud-based tools such as CISO Edge, CHECKLIGHT®, Argo, DISC Next Gen VPN, and Skanda Breach Assessment Tool, delivered as SaaS or managed solutions.

products.name: Identity Management and Systems Integration Services
products.description: Services including identity management, systems integration, biometrics, credentialing, and case management, delivered through consulting and engineering to enhance client security infrastructure.

products.name: PAS-004 (Next-Generation MEK Inhibitor)
products.description: A macrocyclic small molecule allosteric inhibitor of MEK 1/2, developed for oral administration (capsule and tablet formulations), intended for the treatment of RASopathies (including neurofibromatosis type 1), MAPK pathway-driven tumors, and other diseases such as ALS, ETS2-driven diseases, and LMNA cardiomyopathy. Manufactured via contract manufacturing organizations under cGMP, delivered as a pharmaceutical drug product for clinical and, pending approval, commercial use.

products.name: PAS-001 (C4A Inhibitor for Schizophrenia)
products.description: An early-stage, brain-penetrant small molecule drug candidate targeting complement component 4A (C4A) for the systemic treatment of schizophrenia. The product is being developed through medicinal chemistry and preclinical testing, with the aim of providing a novel mechanism for treating schizophrenia by downregulating C4A activity in the central nervous system.

products.name: Monoclonal Antibody Targeting α5β1 Integrin for ALS (Alpha-5 Program)
products.description: A monoclonal antibody therapeutic targeting α5β1 integrin, developed for the treatment of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). The program is supported by grant funding and involves preclinical research and development, with manufacturing and research activities conducted through external partnerships.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of secured and unsecured loans to businesses, including commercial real estate loans, commercial and industrial loans, lines of credit, construction financing, farm loans, and community development loans. These are delivered through in-person relationship banking and require significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers residential real estate loans, mortgage loans, home equity loans, and other consumer loans to individuals. These products are delivered through branch offices and digital channels, requiring underwriting, regulatory compliance, and financial capital.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provides various types of time and demand deposit accounts, including checking, savings, money market, and certificates of deposit, to individuals, businesses, and municipalities. These are delivered through physical branches and digital platforms, and are insured by the FDIC.

products.name: Trust and Retail Investment Services
products.description: Offers trust administration and retail investment services to individuals and businesses, including estate planning, investment management, and custodial services. These services are delivered through specialized staff and require regulatory oversight.

products.name: Insurance Services
products.description: Provides a range of insurance products, including business, home, auto, and employee benefits insurance, through acquired agencies and subsidiaries. Delivery involves licensed insurance producers and is regulated by state insurance authorities.

products.name: Wealth Management and Investment Advisory Services
products.description: Provides wealth management and investment advisory services, including portfolio management and financial planning, primarily through acquired registered investment advisory firms. Delivered by licensed advisors and subject to SEC regulation.

products.name: Cash Management and Treasury Services
products.description: Offers cash management solutions such as online banking, telephone banking, and other treasury services to businesses and consumers. These are delivered digitally and support business operations and liquidity management.

products.name: Neflamapimod for Dementia with Lewy Bodies (DLB)
products.description: An orally administered small-molecule drug developed to treat DLB, particularly in patients without Alzheimer's disease (AD) co-pathology. It is manufactured using commercial contract manufacturing organizations and delivered as an oral capsule, pending regulatory approval.

products.name: Neflamapimod for Nonfluent/Agrammatic Variant Primary Progressive Aphasia (nfvPPA)
products.description: Neflamapimod is being developed as an oral therapy for nfvPPA, a subtype of frontotemporal dementia. The product is delivered as an oral capsule and is in clinical trials to assess safety and efficacy in this indication.

products.name: Neflamapimod for Recovery after Ischemic Stroke
products.description: Neflamapimod is being developed as an oral therapy to improve recovery of motor function after moderate to moderately-severe anterior circulation ischemic stroke. The product is administered orally and is being evaluated in a placebo-controlled clinical trial.

products.name: Neflamapimod for Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)
products.description: Neflamapimod is being developed as an oral therapy for ALS, targeting neuroinflammation and axonal transport defects. It is being evaluated in the EXPERTS-ALS platform trial for its impact on biomarkers and clinical outcomes.

products.name: Neflamapimod for Other Age-Related Brain Disorders
products.description: Neflamapimod is being explored for additional neurodegenerative and age-related brain disorders where neuroinflammation and synaptic dysfunction are key drivers. The product is an orally administered small molecule, with potential expansion into other indications as supported by clinical and scientific rationale.

products.name: Oral IL-23 Receptor Antagonist Therapies (Icotyde)
products.description: Orally administered peptide-based drugs that selectively block the IL-23 receptor, developed using proprietary peptide technology and manufactured by third-party CMOs, for treatment of immune-mediated inflammatory diseases such as psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis, and inflammatory bowel disease. Commercialization is through licensing partnerships (e.g., with JNJ).

products.name: Injectable Hepcidin Mimetics (Rusfertide)
products.description: Injectable peptide drugs that mimic the natural hormone hepcidin, developed via proprietary chemistry and manufactured by third-party CMOs, for the treatment of polycythemia vera and related blood disorders. Commercialization is through co-development and licensing partnerships (e.g., with Takeda).

products.name: Oral IL-17 Antagonist Therapies (PN-881)
products.description: Orally administered peptide-based drugs targeting the IL-17 pathway, developed using proprietary peptide technology and manufactured by third-party CMOs, for treatment of immune-mediated skin and joint diseases such as psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis, hidradenitis suppurativa, and spondyloarthritis.

products.name: Oral Hepcidin Functional Mimetics (PN-8047)
products.description: Orally administered small molecule drugs that functionally mimic hepcidin, developed via proprietary chemistry and manufactured by third-party CMOs, for the treatment of polycythemia vera and related blood disorders, providing an alternative to injectable therapies.

products.name: Oral and Subcutaneous Multi-Agonist Peptide Therapies for Obesity (PN-477, PN-458)
products.description: Oral and subcutaneous peptide-based drugs acting as dual or triple agonists of GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon receptors, developed using proprietary peptide technology and manufactured by third-party CMOs, for chronic weight management and obesity treatment. Both oral and injectable formulations are being developed to address patient and physician preferences.

products.name: Preclinical Oral Peptide and Small Molecule Therapeutics for Inflammatory, Hematologic, and Metabolic Diseases
products.description: Early-stage, preclinical oral peptide and small molecule drug candidates targeting validated biological pathways (e.g., IL-4R alpha antagonists for atopic dermatitis and asthma, amylinR-based agonists for obesity), developed using proprietary discovery platforms and intended for future clinical development and commercialization.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Origination of secured and unsecured loans to businesses for purposes such as working capital, equipment acquisition, and commercial real estate financing. Delivered through in-person banking, digital channels, and includes both term loans and lines of credit.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Provision of loans secured by commercial real estate, including owner-occupied, non-owner occupied, multi-family, residential rental, vacant land, land development, and construction loans. Requires property appraisals and is delivered through branch and relationship banking.

products.name: Single-Family Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination of single-family residential real estate loans, typically conforming to secondary market standards, with fixed or adjustable rates and terms up to 30 years. Loans are delivered through branch offices and digital channels, with many sold to investors.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of consumer loans including auto, boat, credit cards, overdraft protection, and home equity lines of credit. Delivered through branch offices and digital platforms, these loans are typically secured by personal property or real estate.

products.name: Retail Deposit Services
products.description: Offering of checking, savings, and time deposit accounts to individuals and businesses, with access via 54 office locations, ATMs, video banking machines, and digital banking platforms.

products.name: Digital and Mobile Banking Services
products.description: Provision of online and mobile banking platforms enabling customers to conduct loan and deposit transactions remotely, including eStatements and account management. Delivered via proprietary digital applications.

products.name: Safe Deposit Box Rental
products.description: Rental of safe deposit boxes at most office locations for secure storage of valuables. Requires physical infrastructure and in-person access.

products.name: Courier Services for Commercial Customers
products.description: Provision of courier services to certain commercial customers for secure transport of deposits and documents. Delivered via in-person logistics.

products.name: Hard Disk Drives (HDDs)
products.description: Physically manufactured devices that store digitally encoded data on rapidly rotating magnetic disks, used for mass capacity storage in cloud, edge, enterprise, and legacy applications. Delivered as standalone drives or integrated into systems.

products.name: Solid State Drives (SSDs)
products.description: Physically manufactured storage devices using NAND flash memory, offered in various interfaces (SATA, SAS, NVMe) for high-performance, hyperscale, enterprise, consumer, gaming, and NAS applications.

products.name: Enterprise Storage Systems
products.description: Modular, scalable storage subsystems and server platforms built with enterprise HDDs and SSDs, delivered as storage arrays, JBODs, and expansion shelves for data centers, cloud service providers, and OEMs.

products.name: Edge-to-Cloud Mass Data Platform (Lyve)
products.description: A scalable, modular platform including hardware and software for managing, transferring, and storing massive volumes of data across distributed enterprises, featuring data transfer shuttles and storage-as-a-service cloud offerings.

products.name: Video and Image Application (VIA) Drives
products.description: Specialized HDDs designed for high-write workloads in always-on, always-recording video systems, supporting video analytics, security, and smart video installations.

products.name: Network-Attached Storage (NAS) Drives
products.description: HDDs and SSDs engineered for small and medium business network storage environments, featuring custom software for health management, error recovery, and vibration tolerance.

products.name: Mission Critical Storage Drives
products.description: Enterprise-class HDDs and SSDs with high performance and reliability, designed for demanding workloads in mission critical applications such as servers and enterprise storage.

products.name: Consumer External Storage Solutions
products.description: Externally connected HDD and SSD products for consumers, providing backup, augmented storage, and portable storage for PCs, mobile devices, and gaming consoles, sold under various brand names.

products.name: Client Storage Drives
products.description: HDDs and SSDs designed for desktop and notebook computers, DVRs, and gaming systems, providing built-in or external storage for personal and professional use.

products.name: Storage-as-a-Service Cloud (Lyve Cloud)
products.description: A cloud-based, consumption-model object storage service compatible with S3, providing scalable, secure, and cost-effective mass data storage for enterprises across multiple regions.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides various types of credit to business customers, including commercial loans and real estate loans, primarily through in-person relationship banking at physical branches.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers consumer loans to individuals, delivered through branch locations and supported by local banking staff.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provides a full range of deposit accounts to commercial and consumer customers, including checking, savings, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit, managed through physical branches and digital channels.

products.name: Trust and Estate Services
products.description: Offers trust services such as administration of estates, conservatorships, personal trusts, and agency accounts, delivered by specialized staff through in-person and managed account services.

products.name: Treasury Management Services
products.description: Provides business customers with treasury management solutions including online and mobile cash management, ACH transactions, remote deposit capture, lock box, and fraud protection, delivered via digital platforms and specialized support.

products.name: Merchant Services and Corporate Cards
products.description: Offers merchant card processing and corporate credit card services to business customers, enabling payment acceptance and business expense management, delivered through partnerships and digital infrastructure.

products.name: Digital Banking Services
products.description: Provides online and mobile banking platforms for both consumer and business customers, enabling account management, transactions, and access to banking services digitally.

products.name: Airfreight Services
products.description: Procurement and resale of air cargo space, including consolidation and forwarding of shipments, with ancillary services such as documentation, packing, and insurance. Services are delivered through coordination with commercial airlines and require expertise in routing, compliance, and logistics management.

products.name: Ocean Freight and Ocean Services
products.description: Procurement and resale of ocean cargo space as a Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier (NVOCC), including consolidation, direct forwarding, and order management. Services include container allocation, documentation, and management of both full and less-than-container loads, delivered via contracts with ocean carriers and supported by a global network.

products.name: Customs Brokerage and Import Services
products.description: Preparation and filing of customs documentation, calculation and payment of duties and taxes, arrangement of inspections, and import services such as local pickup, storage, and delivery. Services are delivered by licensed professionals and supported by proprietary technology to ensure compliance and efficiency.

products.name: Warehousing and Distribution Services
products.description: Inventory management, multi-channel order fulfillment, vendor managed inventory programs, and value-added services provided in multi-client warehouse facilities. Services leverage shared space, labor, and equipment to deliver cost efficiencies and are integrated with customers' supply chains.

products.name: Ground Transportation (Transcon) Services
products.description: Intra-continental and cross-border ground transportation solutions, including time-definite, less-than-truckload, and full truckload services. Delivered through a network of ground carriers, these services provide door-to-door capacity and are integrated with other logistics offerings.

products.name: Order Management Services
products.description: Management of cargo consolidation at origin, supplier and carrier performance, container and document management, and delivery tracking, enabled by a web-based portal for real-time order and SKU visibility. Services are integrated across transportation modes and focus on optimizing container utilization and supply chain efficiency.

products.name: Project Cargo Services
products.description: Specialized handling and transportation of oversized, heavy-lift, or otherwise complex project shipments, often requiring multimodal solutions and high levels of customized attention. Delivered through dedicated project teams and may involve chartering vessels or aircraft.

products.name: Cargo Insurance Brokerage
products.description: Placement of cargo insurance coverage for customers, covering losses attributable to missing or damaged shipments. Delivered through a licensed insurance brokerage subsidiary and supported by risk assessment and mitigation programs.

products.name: Trade Compliance and Supply Chain Consulting
products.description: Consulting services focused on trade compliance, supply chain analysis, and optimization, including regulatory compliance, reporting, and participation in special trade programs. Delivered by specialized teams and billed on an hourly or project basis.

products.name: Digital Logistics Solutions
products.description: Provision of digital products and platforms for quoting, booking, freight tracing and tracking, customized reporting, data analytics, and supply chain modeling/optimization. Delivered via web-based portals, APIs, and EDI, these solutions enhance visibility and integration for customers’ logistics operations.

products.name: DeepView System (Burn Indication)
products.description: A predictive medical diagnostic platform combining proprietary multispectral imaging hardware and AI algorithms to assess burn wound healing potential. Delivered as a physical imaging device integrated with AI-driven software, requiring regulatory approval as a medical device and used in clinical settings such as burn centers, trauma centers, and emergency rooms.

products.name: DeepView SaaS (Software as a Medical Device)
products.description: A software-as-a-service offering that provides access to the DeepView AI algorithms for wound healing prediction, including software licensing, maintenance, image hosting, and algorithmic updates. Delivered digitally under a SaMD regulatory framework, typically bundled with the imaging device for clinical use.

products.name: DeepView SnapShot M (Handheld Diagnostic Device)
products.description: A fully handheld, portable, and wireless diagnostic device based on the DeepView System’s AI platform, designed for rapid wound assessment in military, emergency, and potentially home healthcare settings. Requires physical manufacturing and is intended for field and point-of-care use.

products.name: 3D Wound Measurement Technology
products.description: A software-based technology for three-dimensional wound measurement, integrated into the DeepView System, providing rapid and accurate assessment of burn area and tissue depth without external markers. Delivered as a digital enhancement to the imaging platform, supporting clinical decision-making.

products.name: DeepView System (Other Indications in Development)
products.description: Pipeline applications of the DeepView System for additional clinical indications beyond burns, such as soft tissue assessment, wound bed preparedness, critical limb ischemia, amputation selection, and post-operative perfusion. These are based on the same core imaging and AI platform, with future commercialization dependent on regulatory clearance and clinical validation.

products.name: Construction Lending
products.description: Origination of construction loans for multi-family, residential condominium, and non-residential properties, primarily in New York and New Jersey. Loans are physically underwritten, require significant documentation, and are managed through in-person inspections and disbursements.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Provision of credit, including term loans and lines of credit, to commercial and industrial businesses and real estate developers. Loans are typically collateralized and require personal guarantees, with rates indexed to the prime rate.

products.name: Multifamily and Mixed-Use Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of adjustable-rate and balloon mortgage loans secured by cooperative apartment buildings and mixed-use properties, primarily in New York and Massachusetts. Loans are physically underwritten and retained in the portfolio.

products.name: Non-Residential Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of mortgage loans secured by office buildings, medical facilities, and retail shopping centers. Loans are physically underwritten, appraised, and inspected, with terms similar to multifamily loans.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of personal loans and overdraft protection for checking accounts, primarily unsecured or secured by rapidly depreciating assets. This is a small, ancillary business line.

products.name: Retail Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a variety of retail deposit products, including checking, savings, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit, to individuals and businesses. Products are delivered through physical branches and digital channels.

products.name: Brokered and Listing Service Deposit Services
products.description: Acquisition of deposits through brokered, listing service, and military deposit channels, often to match the maturity of construction loans. These are managed digitally and supplement retail deposits.

products.name: Home Equity Line of Credit (HELOC) Lending
products.description: Origination, sale, and servicing of home equity line of credit loans to consumers, delivered through a fully automated, blockchain-powered platform that reduces funding time and costs. Loans are originated both directly under the Figure brand and via partner-branded channels using Figure's technology.

products.name: Loan Origination and Servicing Technology Platform (LOS)
products.description: Provision of a proprietary, blockchain-based loan origination system to partners (financial institutions and lenders) enabling them to originate, process, and service loans efficiently, with automation of underwriting, funding, and servicing processes.

products.name: Figure Connect Loan Marketplace
products.description: A blockchain-enabled electronic marketplace connecting loan originators, buyers, and investors for the direct sale and purchase of loans, enhancing liquidity and transparency in the secondary loan market.

products.name: Digital Asset Exchange (Figure Exchange)
products.description: A digital asset marketplace for trading cryptocurrencies and tokenized assets, offering features such as cross-asset collateralization for margin lending, built on blockchain infrastructure.

products.name: Interest-Bearing Stablecoin (YLDS)
products.description: An SEC-registered, interest-bearing, peer-to-peer transferable stablecoin native to public blockchain, used for collateral, payments, and as a store of value, with institutional and retail applications.

products.name: Democratized Prime Platform (DeFi Lending Marketplace)
products.description: A decentralized, blockchain-based marketplace connecting lenders and borrowers, allowing users to lend assets or cash at market-clearing rates with pro-rata exposure and automated collateral management.

products.name: On-Chain Public Equity Network (OPEN)
products.description: A blockchain-based network for the issuance, trading, custody, and lending of public equity securities, enabling companies to issue equity natively on blockchain and facilitating 24/7 trading and self-custody.

products.name: Metallurgical Coal
products.description: Coal mined and processed primarily for use in steelmaking, produced via underground and surface mining methods, processed at company-owned preparation plants, and delivered to domestic and international steel industry customers.

products.name: Pulverized Coal Injection (PCI) Coal
products.description: Specialty coal product used in the steelmaking process, produced from underground and surface mines, processed at preparation plants, and sold to steel mills for injection into blast furnaces.

products.name: Industrial and Specialty Coal Products
products.description: High-BTU, low sulfur, low moisture bituminous coal produced for industrial customers and specialty uses, extracted via mining and processed at company facilities.

products.name: Coal Processing and Preparation Services
products.description: Processing, storage, and loading of coal for third-party regional coal producers at company-owned preparation plants, utilizing large-scale physical infrastructure and rail loadouts.

products.name: Recovered Metal and Steel Aggregation and Sales
products.description: Aggregation, recovery, and sale of recovered metal and steel, including materials sourced from waste streams, managed by Electrified Materials Corporation (EMC).

products.name: Rare Earth Element Purification and Monetization
products.description: Purification and monetization of critical and rare earth element deposits and end-of-life magnets and batteries, involving chemical processing and resale of purified materials, managed by ReElement Technologies.

products.name: Aqueous Ozone Cleaning Systems
products.description: Manufactured devices and systems that generate and dispense pure aqueous ozone using patented nanobubble technology for cleaning, sanitizing, and deodorizing surfaces in professional, industrial, and home environments. Delivered as wall-mounted fill stations, portable caddies, and custom high-volume systems, these products require physical manufacturing and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Ice Machine Cleaning Systems
products.description: Specialized aqueous ozone-based systems designed to clean and sanitize commercial ice machines by automatically delivering ozone-infused water to prevent bacterial and mold buildup. These are manufactured devices installed in ice machines for ongoing cleaning.

products.name: Aqueous Ozone Laundry Systems
products.description: Aqueous ozone units connected to commercial and residential washing machines to clean, oxidize, and deodorize laundry without harsh chemicals, extending linen life and reducing skin irritation. These are manufactured devices requiring installation and physical production.

products.name: Industrial Aqueous Ozone Cleaning Systems
products.description: Custom high-capacity aqueous ozone systems for industrial cleaning applications, including food processing, packaging, and manufacturing plants. These systems are tailored to client needs, with adjustable volume and concentration, and require physical manufacturing and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Sanitizing and Disinfectant Tablets
products.description: Chlorinated tablets branded as 'GreenKlean' that dissolve in water to create a sanitizing and disinfecting solution for hard, non-porous surfaces. These are manufactured consumable products, standardized for single-use cleaning doses.

products.name: Oil and Gas Royalty Interests
products.description: The Trust owns overriding royalty interests in producing oil and gas properties located in the Hugoton field of Kansas and the San Juan Basin fields of New Mexico and Colorado. The Trust receives a percentage of net proceeds from the sale of oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids produced and sold by the working interest owners. The Trust does not operate the properties or market the production itself; it passively collects royalty income based on production and sales by third-party operators.

products.name: Water Utility Services
products.description: Provision of drinking water services to residential, commercial, industrial, public authority, fire service, and resale customers through regulated utilities. Services involve sourcing, treating, and distributing water using owned infrastructure and are subject to extensive regulation.

products.name: Wastewater Utility Services
products.description: Collection, treatment, and recycling of wastewater for residential, commercial, industrial, and public authority customers using owned sewer networks and treatment facilities. Services are regulated and require significant physical infrastructure and compliance with environmental standards.

products.name: Water and Wastewater Services for Military Installations
products.description: Operation, maintenance, and capital improvement of water and wastewater systems on U.S. military installations under long-term contracts, including asset replacement and system expansion. Services are delivered through dedicated teams and require compliance with government contract requirements.

products.name: Contract Operations and Management Services for Municipalities
products.description: Operation and management of water and wastewater facilities for municipal customers under contract, including related services. These contracts typically do not require significant capital investment by the company and are not subject to state utility regulation.

products.name: Gift Card Exchange Platform
products.description: A digital marketplace facilitating the buying and selling of unused gift cards from over 1,100 retailers, using proprietary fraud-prevention technology and operating both B2C and B2B channels. The platform purchases gift cards at a discount and resells them to consumers and businesses nationwide, including bulk and white-label solutions for partners.

products.name: Branded Gift Card Exchange Solutions
products.description: White-label and branded exchange platforms integrated into partner retailer websites, allowing retailers to offer gift card exchange services to their customers and drive additional revenue, supported by CardCash’s technology and marketplace infrastructure.

products.name: Gift Card Incentives and Bulk Procurement
products.description: Provision of new gift cards for over 300 brands at discounted rates to businesses for use in employee engagement, customer loyalty, and incentive programs, including the CardCash uChoose platform for customizable bulk gift card offerings.

products.name: Discounted Restaurant Certificates
products.description: Digital certificates for discounts at over 10,000 restaurants, sold directly to consumers and businesses, redeemable via web and mobile platforms, and never expiring. These are distributed through Restaurant.com’s online marketplace.

products.name: Discount Dining Passes
products.description: Multi-use passes providing discounts at 170,000 restaurants and other retailers for a six-month period, sold to both consumers and businesses for use in loyalty, marketing, and promotional programs.

products.name: Bundled Specials (Restaurant Certificates + Entertainment/Travel)
products.description: Bundled offerings that combine restaurant certificates with entertainment, travel, wine, and other experiences, sold through Restaurant.com to consumers, generating higher average order values and cross-promotional opportunities with small businesses.

products.name: Third-Party Offers and Display Advertising
products.description: Revenue from third-party offers and display ads shown to Restaurant.com users, representing a minor ancillary business line.

products.name: Environmental Control Systems for Indoor Agriculture
products.description: Custom-designed air handling equipment and systems, including chilled water systems, custom air handling units, split systems, and packaged roof-top units, specifically engineered for controlled environment agriculture (CEA) facilities. These systems are manufactured and delivered as physical equipment, often requiring installation and ongoing maintenance.

products.name: Air Sanitation Products for CEA Facilities
products.description: Products designed to sanitize and maintain air quality within indoor cultivation environments, delivered as physical equipment and integrated into facility infrastructure to reduce bio-security risks and comply with regulatory standards.

products.name: LED Lighting Solutions for Indoor Cultivation
products.description: LED lighting systems tailored for indoor agriculture, manufactured and supplied to optimize crop growth and energy efficiency in CEA facilities. These are physical products installed in cultivation environments.

products.name: Benching and Racking Solutions for Indoor Cultivation
products.description: Physical benching and racking systems designed for use in indoor agriculture and vertical farming, enabling efficient use of space and supporting plant growth infrastructure.

products.name: Facility Design, Engineering, and Advisory Services for CEA
products.description: Professional services including facility design, budgeting, equipment selection and specification, installation advisory, training, and preventative maintenance, delivered by in-person experts to support the complete lifecycle of indoor agriculture facilities.

products.name: E-cigarettes, Vape Devices, and E-liquids (Fat Panda)
products.description: Manufacture, distribution, and retail sale of e-cigarettes, vape devices, and e-liquids, including proprietary premium e-liquids, through physical retail locations and an online e-commerce platform. Products are produced in-house and distributed via retail and online channels.

products.name: Sezzle Platform (Buy Now, Pay Later Services)
products.description: A digital payments platform offering consumers instant credit at the point-of-sale, enabling purchases with installment payment plans (e.g., pay-in-four, pay-in-two, pay-in-five, customized terms) both online and in-store. The platform is integrated with merchants via APIs, widgets, or virtual cards, and is supported by proprietary underwriting and risk management systems.

products.name: Sezzle Virtual Card
products.description: A virtual payment card, issued in partnership with WebBank and Visa, that allows consumers to use Sezzle’s installment payment services at both integrated and non-integrated merchants, in-store and online, including via Apple Pay and Google Pay. The card is digital-only and leverages regulated payment network infrastructure.

products.name: Sezzle Premium and Sezzle Anywhere (Subscription Services)
products.description: Paid subscription services providing consumers with expanded access to premium and non-integrated merchants, exclusive deals, discounts, additional payment rescheduling, and rewards (Sezzle Spend). Delivered digitally via recurring fees, these services enhance the core Sezzle Platform experience.

products.name: Sezzle On-Demand
products.description: A pay-per-use service allowing non-subscribers to access Sezzle’s installment payment platform at any merchant (online or in-store) for a finance charge, available in select states. This service is delivered digitally and leverages the Sezzle Virtual Card infrastructure.

products.name: Sezzle Balance (Stored-Value Account)
products.description: A stored-value digital wallet product enabling consumers to load and maintain funds within their Sezzle account for use toward eligible purchases or payments on the Sezzle Platform. Funds can be loaded via refunds, rewards, or linked bank accounts, subject to fees and limits.

products.name: Sezzle Up (Credit Reporting Service)
products.description: An opt-in feature that reports consumers’ Sezzle Platform payment history to credit bureaus, helping users build or improve their credit records. This is a digital service integrated into the Sezzle Platform, requiring additional consumer verification steps.

products.name: Long-Term Lending Referral Service
products.description: A referral service connecting consumers to third-party lenders for interest-bearing, fixed-rate installment loans (up to $15,000, up to 60 months) for larger purchases. Sezzle processes applications and provides underwriting analysis but does not originate or hold the loans, earning fees from lending partners.

products.name: Merchant Payment Processing and Checkout Solutions
products.description: Payment processing services for merchants, including integration of Sezzle’s installment payment options, express checkout, and merchant onboarding. Delivered via APIs, widgets, and virtual card acceptance, these services are designed to increase merchant sales and reduce cart abandonment, with revenue from processing fees.

products.name: Merchant Marketing and Paid Placement Services
products.description: Marketing services for merchants, including paid placements on the Sezzle Platform, co-branded marketing initiatives, and inclusion in Sezzle’s consumer marketplace. These digital marketing services are designed to drive consumer traffic and user acquisition for merchants.

products.name: Sezzle Earn Tab and Consumer Rewards
products.description: A digital rewards and engagement platform within the Sezzle app, offering consumers credits (Sezzle Spend) for completing activities such as shopping, playing games, engaging with financial literacy modules, and referring friends. Credits can be redeemed for future purchases within the Sezzle ecosystem.

products.name: Retail and Commercial Banking Services
products.description: Provides a comprehensive range of banking services including deposit accounts, consumer and commercial loans, and digital banking through a network of physical branches and online platforms. Delivery requires regulated infrastructure, physical branches, and digital systems.

products.name: Employee Benefit and Retirement Plan Services
products.description: Offers administration of employee benefit trusts, collective investment funds, retirement plans, health savings accounts, fund administration, transfer agency, actuarial, and health and welfare consulting services to clients nationwide. Services are delivered through specialized subsidiaries and require regulatory compliance and professional expertise.

products.name: Insurance and Risk Management Services
products.description: Provides personal and commercial lines of insurance, risk management products, and employee benefit-related insurance services as a full-service insurance agency. Delivery involves licensed professionals and partnerships with leading insurance carriers.

products.name: Wealth Management and Investment Advisory Services
products.description: Delivers wealth management, retirement planning, fiduciary, trust, risk management, and personal financial planning services, including access to investment products such as stocks, bonds, ETFs, mutual funds, and insurance. Services are provided through registered investment advisors and broker-dealer subsidiaries, requiring regulatory oversight and financial expertise.

products.name: Oral TPOXX (Tecovirimat)
products.description: An orally administered antiviral drug for the treatment of smallpox, monkeypox (mpox), cowpox, and vaccinia complications, produced via pharmaceutical manufacturing using contract manufacturing organizations and sold primarily to government agencies and international customers.

products.name: Intravenous (IV) TPOXX (Tecovirimat)
products.description: An intravenous formulation of the antiviral drug tecovirimat for the treatment of smallpox, manufactured by third-party contract manufacturers and sold primarily to the U.S. Government for stockpiling and emergency preparedness.

products.name: AvePoint Confidence Platform and Related Cloud Services
products.description: A cloud-hosted software platform delivered via third-party hyperscaler cloud providers, offering data management, security, governance, and compliance solutions for enterprise customers. Delivered as SaaS and integrates with various IT environments.

products.name: Professional Services (Implementation, Support, and Training)
products.description: Services provided to customers for onboarding, implementation, technical support, and training related to the AvePoint platform and products. Delivered by in-person or remote human labor, often as paid add-ons to software subscriptions.

products.name: Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) Platform
products.description: A cloud-based, AI-native platform that unifies customer experience management across digital and traditional channels, integrating data, workflows, and AI to enable enterprises to manage customer interactions, insights, marketing, and service at scale. Delivered as SaaS, it consolidates multiple customer-facing functions into a single platform.

products.name: Sprinklr Service (AI-based Customer Service Suite)
products.description: A suite of AI-powered, cloud-native customer service solutions enabling enterprises to deliver omnichannel support across voice, digital, and social channels, including AI agents, live chat, voice bots, workforce management, and analytics. Delivered as SaaS, it automates and enhances contact center operations and customer support.

products.name: Sprinklr Social (Social Media Management Suite)
products.description: A suite of AI-powered tools for managing social media publishing, engagement, influencer management, employee advocacy, and analytics across 30+ channels. Delivered as SaaS, it enables enterprises to coordinate social media activities, automate workflows, and ensure compliance at scale.

products.name: Sprinklr Insights (Customer Intelligence & Analytics Suite)
products.description: A suite of AI-native products that unify and analyze customer feedback and signals from social, digital, and enterprise channels to deliver real-time consumer intelligence, sentiment analysis, benchmarking, and actionable insights. Delivered as SaaS, it supports decision-making and crisis management for enterprises.

products.name: Sprinklr Marketing (Marketing Operations & Campaign Management Suite)
products.description: A suite of AI-based solutions for managing the full marketing campaign lifecycle, including planning, content production, publishing, paid advertising, analytics, and governance across digital channels. Delivered as SaaS, it centralizes and automates marketing operations for efficiency and compliance.

products.name: Professional Services (Implementation, Training, Managed Services)
products.description: A set of advisory, implementation, training, and managed services delivered by certified consultants to help customers deploy, optimize, and maximize value from the Sprinklr platform. Services are delivered virtually or in-person and tailored to customer needs.

products.name: Technology Management as a Service (TMaaS)
products.description: A comprehensive, hosted, and secure platform providing communications management, identity management, and mobility management solutions, delivered via a flexible 'As-a-Service' model to both public and private sector clients. TMaaS is accessible through secure portals and is configurable to meet diverse customer requirements without custom software development.

products.name: Telecom Lifecycle Management
products.description: End-to-end management of telecom assets for enterprises, including asset visibility, cost reduction, and 24/7 call center support, delivered in a secure, hosted environment.

products.name: Mobile and Identity Management
products.description: Provision of federally certified digital certificates, multifactor authentication, and mobile security solutions for secure access to government and enterprise systems, including both virtual and physical access controls. Delivered via secure portals and compliant with federal standards.

products.name: Digital Billing and Unified Communications Analytics Solutions
products.description: Hosted, interactive billing communications and analytics solutions for communications service providers, enabling online bill presentment, analysis, and revenue model visibility through advanced self-serve portals.

products.name: Information Technology as a Service (ITaaS)
products.description: Comprehensive IT outsourcing solutions including cybersecurity, cloud services, network operations, hardware and software management, and professional services, delivered from the cloud for scalability and security. Includes cloud migration and AI implementation.

products.name: Carrier Services
products.description: Procurement, processing, and payment of phone, data, and satellite carrier services for connected devices, including invoice consolidation and administration across multiple carriers. Primarily a commodity service required for full-service federal government solutions.

products.name: Device-as-a-Service and Mobility Management Depot Services
products.description: Provisioning, warehousing, configuration, and lifecycle management of mobile devices and accessories, including recycling services, supported by dedicated facilities for device handling and IT configuration.

products.name: Net Lease of Convenience Store Properties
products.description: Leasing of convenience store real estate to external operators under triple-net leases. Properties are typically located in high-traffic areas and require real estate acquisition, development, and management expertise.

products.name: Net Lease of Automotive Service Properties
products.description: Leasing of automotive service centers, including gasoline and repair, oil and maintenance, tire and battery, and collision centers, to external tenants under triple-net leases. Involves acquisition, redevelopment, and management of specialized automotive real estate.

products.name: Net Lease of Express Tunnel Car Wash Properties
products.description: Leasing of express tunnel car wash real estate to external operators under triple-net leases. Requires acquisition and development of properties suitable for car wash operations.

products.name: Net Lease of Drive-Thru Quick Service Restaurant Properties
products.description: Leasing of drive-thru quick service restaurant real estate to external tenants under triple-net leases. Involves acquisition and development of properties designed for restaurant operations.

products.name: Net Lease of Other Single Tenant Retail Properties
products.description: Leasing of other freestanding single tenant retail properties, such as bank branches and automotive parts retailers, to external tenants under triple-net leases. Involves acquisition and management of diverse retail real estate assets.

products.name: Major League Baseball Franchise Operations
products.description: Operation of the Atlanta Braves Major League Baseball team, including organizing and hosting professional baseball games at Truist Park, which requires in-person athletic performance, event management, and regulated league participation.

products.name: Ticket Sales
products.description: Sales of single game, group, and season tickets for attendance at Atlanta Braves home games, primarily distributed as mobile tickets and recognized during the MLB season.

products.name: Concessions and Catering
products.description: Provision of food and beverage services, including concessions during games and catering in suites and premium areas at Truist Park, requiring in-person service and food preparation.

products.name: Broadcasting Rights and Media Content
products.description: Sale of local and national television, radio, and digital broadcasting rights for Braves games, including operation of BravesVision, a multimedia platform, and participation in MLB-negotiated national media deals.

products.name: Advertising and Sponsorships
products.description: Sale of advertising and sponsorship opportunities at Truist Park, The Battery Atlanta, and through team media, including in-stadium signage, digital boards, jersey patches, and promotional activities, requiring marketing and partnership management.

products.name: Retail Merchandise and Licensing
products.description: Sale of Braves-branded merchandise and licensing of team intellectual property, including retail stores at Truist Park and licensing agreements for use of the Braves name and logo, involving physical and digital product distribution.

products.name: Suites and Premium Seating
products.description: Leasing of luxury suites and premium seating at Truist Park, including hospitality clubs and premium seat fees, requiring facility management and event services.

products.name: Mixed-Use Real Estate Leasing and Operations
products.description: Leasing and management of office, retail, hotel, and entertainment properties within The Battery Atlanta and adjacent developments, generating rental income and tenant reimbursements, requiring real estate development and property management.

products.name: Parking Services
products.description: Provision of parking facilities and services at Truist Park and The Battery Atlanta, generating revenue from event and daily parking, requiring physical infrastructure and operations.

products.name: Protein Processing Solutions
products.description: Integrated systems and equipment for primary, secondary, and further processing of animal proteins (poultry, beef, pork, seafood), including live animal handling, slaughtering, deboning, portioning, chilling, freezing, and robotic batching. These solutions require physical manufacturing, automation, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Prepared Food and Beverage Processing Solutions
products.description: Systems and equipment for value-added preparation, preservation, and packaging of foods and beverages, including ready-to-eat meals, dairy, bakery, pet food, soups, sauces, juices, and nutraceuticals. Solutions span forming, slicing, cooking, freezing, blending, filling, labeling, and packaging, delivered via physical manufacturing and automation.

products.name: Fruit and Vegetable Processing Equipment
products.description: Equipment and systems for industrial processing of fruits and vegetables, including cleaning, grading, storing, slicing, washing, drying, mixing, juicing, and post-harvest treatments. Delivered via physical manufacturing and often customized for customer needs.

products.name: Food and Beverage Packaging Solutions
products.description: Labeling and packaging systems, tray sealers, weigh price labelers, and case packers for automatic in-line packaging of food and beverage products. Includes solutions to extend shelf life and reduce packaging waste, requiring physical manufacturing and automation.

products.name: Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) Systems
products.description: Robotic automated guided vehicle systems for material handling in food, beverage, automotive, warehousing, and medical facilities. Includes engineering services, hardware, software, and fully integrated solutions, delivered via physical manufacturing and digital controls.

products.name: Aftermarket Products, Parts, and Services
products.description: Aftermarket parts, consumables, retrofits, refurbishments, maintenance, and consulting services for installed food processing systems and equipment. Includes preventative maintenance agreements, technical support, and proprietary consumables, delivered via in-person service and logistics.

products.name: Food Processing Software and Controls
products.description: Software platforms (e.g., AXIN) and controls for optimizing food processing operations, including machine control, real-time monitoring, data analytics, and compliance reporting. Delivered digitally and integrated with hardware systems.

products.name: Food Safety and Regulatory Consulting Services
products.description: Consulting services to design food production processes in compliance with USDA and FDA requirements, including process auditing, water treatment, and food safety expertise. Delivered via in-person and remote expert consulting.

products.name: Gas Fermentation Technology Platform
products.description: A proprietary biotechnology platform that uses specialized microbes to convert waste gases (CO, CO2, H2) from industrial, municipal, and agricultural sources into ethanol and other chemicals. Delivered via licensing or co-development, it requires bioreactor infrastructure, microbe supply, and software support.

products.name: CarbonSmart Ethanol and Ethanol-Derived Products
products.description: Production and supply of ethanol made from waste gases, which can be used directly as fuel or as a chemical building block for further conversion into sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), diesel, ethylene, polyethylene, PET, surfactants, and glycols. Delivered through commercial plants using the company’s technology.

products.name: Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) and Renewable Diesel
products.description: Production and supply of SAF and renewable diesel from ethanol using the Alcohol-to-Jet (ATJ) process, often in partnership with LanzaJet. These fuels are produced from a wide range of waste feedstocks and are qualified for commercial aviation use. Delivered via joint offerings and technology licensing.

products.name: Industrial Protein and Animal Feed
products.description: Production and supply of protein-rich byproducts from the gas fermentation process, used locally as industrial protein, animal feed, fish feed, and fertilizers. Delivered as a co-product from commercial fermentation plants.

products.name: Licensing and Engineering Services
products.description: Licensing of proprietary technology, sale of microbe supplies, and provision of research, engineering, and software support services to partners who own and operate fermentation plants. Includes co-development and minority investment in select projects.

products.name: Broadcast Television Station Operations
products.description: Operation and programming of local broadcast television stations, including network, syndicated, and original content, delivered over-the-air and via distribution agreements with cable, satellite, and OTT platforms. Requires regulated infrastructure, physical broadcast assets, and in-person production teams.

products.name: Original Content Production (News, Sports, Entertainment)
products.description: Production and distribution of original programming, including local and national news, investigative journalism, live local and national sports, and entertainment shows, delivered via broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms. Requires in-person labor, production facilities, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Owned and Operated Digital Networks
products.description: Operation of proprietary digital multicast and broadcast networks (e.g., The Nest, Comet, CHARGE!, ROAR) offering genre-specific programming, distributed over-the-air and through third-party platforms. Requires broadcast infrastructure and content acquisition/production.

products.name: Tennis Media and Streaming Services
products.description: Operation of Tennis Channel (cable network), Tennis Channel International, Tennis Channel streaming service, TennisChannel 2 (FAST channel), Tennis.com, and Pickleballtv, providing live and on-demand tennis and pickleball content globally via cable, streaming, and digital platforms. Requires content rights, digital infrastructure, and production teams.

products.name: Digital Advertising and Marketing Services
products.description: Provision of digital advertising, marketing technology, and managed services to external clients, including licensing of marketing platforms and execution of digital media campaigns across search, social, programmatic, and email. Delivered digitally via proprietary and third-party platforms.

products.name: Technical Services for Broadcast Industry
products.description: Design, manufacture, and provision of broadcast systems and technical services (e.g., antennas, transmitters, NextGen TV technologies) to other broadcasters and third parties. Requires physical manufacturing, engineering expertise, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Wireless Data Services via NextGen TV
products.description: Provision of wireless data services to businesses and industries using NextGen TV (ATSC 3.0) spectrum and infrastructure, including data delivery, connectivity, and related solutions. Requires regulated spectrum, broadcast infrastructure, and technology partnerships.

products.name: Podcast Production and Distribution
products.description: Production and distribution of original podcasts focused on sports, news, and entertainment, available across major podcast platforms. Delivered digitally, requires content creation and digital distribution infrastructure.
